seoTitle: PDF Text Extractor API: text, metadata & links from PDF URLs
seoDescription: Extract full text, per-page text, metadata and links from PDF URLs as JSON for RAG, LLM ingestion and archives. $0.004 per PDF, failed downloads are free.

pdf-processed.eventDescription: One PDF downloaded and its text, per-page text, metadata and links extracted (up to the configured page limit). Unreachable URLs, non-PDF responses, oversized or password-protected files and scanned PDFs without a text layer are not charged.
